map.铁锈色痰高度提示大叶性肺炎(肺炎链球菌)，结合高热胸痛经验性抗感染。: Rusty sputum strongly suggests lobar pneumonia (pneumococcus); with high fever and chest pain start empirical antibiotics.
map.粉红色泡沫痰为急性肺水肿急症，立即坐位吸氧利尿扩血管。: Pink frothy sputum indicates acute pulmonary edema - an emergency; sit the patient up, give oxygen, diuretics and vasodilators immediately.
map.恶臭提示厌氧菌(肺脓肿/支扩)，需覆盖甲硝唑/克林霉素。: Foul odor suggests anaerobes (lung abscess / bronchiectasis); cover with metronidazole / clindamycin.
map.中老年咯血查胸部 CT 与支气管镜，排外结核/肺癌。: Hemoptysis in middle-aged or older patients needs chest CT and bronchoscopy to exclude TB / lung cancer.
